title: Contents Packout & Storage — Storage Days the Carrier Does Not Pay
content:
The carrier pays storage only through the approved storage end date. For the customer's share on an insurance-funded Contents Packout & Storage job of Partial Contents Packout or Full Contents Packout: **the share carries the job's most recent vault, climate vault and oversized item storage lines billed to the insurance claim, taken together, times the uncovered days, divided by the tier's period length; the uncovered days are counted from the day after a cut-off date through the last day of the storage period that contains that date, and the storage extension request read is the one for this job that asks for the latest end date; when the approved storage end date falls before today and before the last day of its storage period and that request asks for an end date later than the approved storage end date and inside the same period, the cut-off is the requested end date; when the approved storage end date falls before today and before the last day of its storage period and no request for this job asks for an end date later than the approved storage end date, the cut-off is the approved storage end date; in every other case there are no uncovered days.**

Storage periods are counted in whole periods of the tier's period length from the custody start date recorded on the job.

## Records read

- The approved storage end date on the Insurance Claim Services claim file linked to the job.
- The storage extension requests recorded on that file for this contents job, and the end date each asks for.
- The job's storage lines billed to the insurance claim: the most recent vault line, the most recent climate vault line and the most recent oversized item line, by the first day of their period.

## Cut-off table

| Approved storage end date | Extension request for this job asking the latest end date | Cut-off | Uncovered days |
|---|---|---|---|
| before today and before the last day of its period | asks for a later date inside the same period | the requested end date | day after the requested date through the period's last day |
| before today and before the last day of its period | no request asks for a later date | the approved storage end date | day after the approved date through the period's last day |
| before today and before the last day of its period | asks for a later date outside that period | — | none |
| today or later, or on the last day of its period | any | — | none |

## Cases (hypothetical: 30-day periods, custody from 1 June, so a period runs 1 July to 30 July)

- Approved end 10 July, no later request: uncovered days 11 July through 30 July, 20 days.
- Approved end 10 July, a request asking 18 July: 19 July through 30 July, 12 days.
- Approved end 10 July, a request asking 3 August: no uncovered days.
- With a most recent insurance-billed vault line of 300.00 and oversized item line of 60.00, 20 uncovered days carry 360.00 times 20 divided by 30, or 240.00.
